lines: Gang Member
「Filthy bums! This is our organization's turf. Unless you wanna die, hurry up and get outta here!」
Armed Refugee
「You're the filthy ones, ya greedy gangbangers! I'm sick of hearin' you whine, “Our organization, our organization!”」
Gang Member
「Huh?! Don't get cocky, when yer only scavengin' trash in the streets!」
Armed Refugee
「Better than some organization's dogs. What happened to your tails? They come off from waggin' too hard?」
Gang Member
「Wha'd you say? You wanna get slaughtered right now?!」
Armed Refugee
「Try it if ya can, small fries!!」
This was the harbour district of the abandoned city on Tokyo Bay, Tokyo Kingdom.
Gang members from a certain organization, and armed refugees who had made this territory their base, were glaring at each other, weapons in hand.
Arguments of this magnitude, and even exchanges of gunfire, were an everyday occurrence in these parts.
Usually, it started with a confrontation, then yelling, then indiscriminate shooting from both sides, and then reaching a compromise.
There would probably be one or two people injured or dead, but it was rare for things to degenerate into some huge disaster, such as either side (or both) getting wiped out.
It was the unique way of life in dangerous areas where small-scale conflicts were the norm.
However, on this day, the situation was a little different.
Gang Member
「I'm real fed up of dealing with you guys. Today, I brought some good vacuums to clean you up with!」
What the gang members had proudly unveiled were a number of Drone Dogs.
They were powerful, combat-oriented robot dogs, equipped with various sensors and machine guns, which the UFS had developed by making use of Demon World technology.
They were originally standardized military weapons, but, despite the drones that appeared all having the same base, different repairs had been conducted on each of them.
They were unusual repairs, of the kind where one could tell from a glance that they had forcibly replaced the broken drones' missing parts with other things.
As proof of that, the movement of the Drone Dogs, which by nature would be smoother than a flesh-and-blood dog's, was jerky.
It seemed like the gang members had taken it upon themselves to repair, and put to use, the scraps of drones that had been destroyed in this city.
Gang Member
「Once these're sicced on ya, the likes of you guys'll be mincemeat in a matter of seconds!」
Gang Member
「Get outta here right away, before you're ground bee―――Wha?!」
The looks on the faces of the gang members, who had tried to threaten them with the drones, changed.
Because, making creaking sounds, drones appeared from the armed refugees' side as well.
These were Drone Ants, modelled after enormous ants.
As before, each and every one of them had been given sloppy repairs by amateurs.
Armed Refugee
「Scavenging trash is our speciality!」
Gang Member
「Assholes!」
Armed Refugee
「We're gonna settle this today for sure!!」
Gang Member
「You want some of this?!!」
The gang members, and the armed refugees.
The bloodthirst on both sides suddenly skyrocketed.

With pistols or rifles, this turf dispute would have been over after a brief shootout, like always, but because they had prepared these drones, it was about to develop into a lethal massacre. At that moment,
A girl suddenly dropped down and stood right in between the gang members and the armed refugees.
Asuka
「Okay, okay, wait a minute.」
The one who had let out a voice with zero sense of tension was the “Steel Taimanin”, Koukawa Asuka.
Gang Member
「A woman??」
Armed Refugee
「Who're you?!」
Surprised voices arose from both sides, but she completely ignored them, and first looked at the drones to her left and right.
Asuka
「Whoooaaa～～～, you've really messed them up. This is why amateurs are to be feared. Haaah.」
After screwing up her face and breathing a sigh, she addressed the gang members and armed refugees once again.
Asuka
「You guys are free to squabble here, but could you give us our drones back?」
Asuka
「Demon World tech is too much for you guys to handle. It's really dangerous, after all.」
Asuka
「Do your fighting with those guns or something, okay? Just enough to avoid seriously hurting anyone. That would be best.」
Her phrasing appeared to be intended to persuade them, but her indifferent face and voice were betraying that.
Not to mention that she was a beautiful girl, who seemed unlikely to have anything to do with the ruffians of Tokyo Kingdom in her entire life.
Generally speaking, any of them would have thought they were being made fun of.
And these gang members and armed refugees thought that as well.
Gang Member
「Wha'd you say, bitch?!!」
Armed Refugee
「We're gonna dispose o' you first!!」
The gang members and armed refugees gave orders to their respective drones, and tried to make them attack Asuka.
The drones pointed their machine guns at her with jerky movements.
Asuka
「Hahhh. Guys like this won't understand unless you show them your strength, huh?」
Contrary to that remark to herself, Asuka's eyes had lit up like she was pleased.
The drones' machine guns fired, not all at once, but in separate bursts.
Gagagann...... Gann...... Gagann......
Though it may have been irregular and poorly-aimed, it was a shooting attack from both sides by a multitude of drones.
As one of the gang members had bragged, an ordinary human would be mincemeat in seconds.
Asuka
「Oh yeah?」
And she was defending against that effortlessly.
The Steel Taimanin―――Her steel limbs, which were the origin of that nickname, were deflecting the entire hail of bullets.
There wasn't a scratch put on her shiny Android Arms and Legs.
Asuka
「At least you've made sure the machine guns work properly.」
After nodding like she was impressed,
Asuka
「But that's about it, huh?!!」
She pointed her left arm at the pack of Drone Dogs.
Asuka
「Android Arm: “Annihilating Machine Gun”!!!!」
Her bullets, which were so powerful and well-aimed that the drones couldn't compare, destroyed the mechanical dogs in no time.
Asuka
「This one's for the ants!」
Asuka
「Android Arm: “Annihilation Missile”!!!!」
Next, the miniature missiles which she fired blew up all of the Drone Ants in one go.
The dogs and the ants were pieces of scrap. There was no way to repair them now.
And despite firing so ostentatiously, she hadn't hit a single one of the surrounding people.
Asuka
「Demon World tech is scary! Never, ever use it without authorization! You got that?! C'mon, answer!」
Due to the sight of her even going so far as to lecture them as she destroyed their drones, the gang members and armed refugees appeared to have finally realized her true identity.
Gang Member
「Those mechanical limbs... Don't tell me that woman's―――」
Armed Refugee
「Th-The Steel Reaper?!」
Asuka
「You finally remembered me? Yes, that's right! I'm―――」
「Th-The Scrap Metal Woman?!」
Whether gang member or armed refugee, some thoughtless person blurted that out, and the next moment,
Asuka
「Who's a scrap metal woman?!!!」
Asuka opened her eyes wide in anger and brought both of her Android Arms together.
All of the drones were already destroyed.
In spite of that, glowing Taima particles were converging between both of those arms.
With much more tremendous energy.
Gang Members & Armed Refugees

「Hiiiiiiiih!!」
「Help meeeee!!」
Next to the drones, which had been reduced to scrap metal, the gang members and armed refugees screamed in unison.
Asuka
「Take this to heart! Never lay a hand on Demon World tech again! Or else it'll turn out like this!」
Asuka
「Killer Blow: Taima Super-Particle Cannoooooonnnnnnnn!!!!!!!」
Asuka
「And well, like that, it was basically mission complete. Cool, right?」
Asuka said boastfully.
The heroic figure of herself firing her Taima Super-Particle Cannon into the night sky was displayed on the big-screen monitor she was watching.
This was a lab of the UFS's Defence Sciences Office, commonly known as the DSO.
Having finished her mission in Tokyo Kingdom, she was showing her colleagues some footage from before, as she underwent maintenance with her limbs off.
Anje
「Yeah, amazing.」
Said Anje, a modified human who had had the powers of demons and Taimanin transplanted into her.
Her face looked like she didn't think it was that great, but it was normal for her to be dispassionate about everything.
Asuka
「Just how amazing?」
Anje
「About... three rice balls' worth?」
Asuka
「Three, huh?♪」
Asuka was smiling in satisfaction at Anje's evaluation, even though she didn't really understand it.
Alberta
「Pretty flashily done.」
Letting out a slightly exasperated-sounding voice was Alberta.
She was a dark elf, with characteristic pale-blue skin and pointed ears (in other words, a demon), and had a cooperative relationship with the DSO.
Alberta
「That thing at the end... It didn't wipe out the humans who were there, right?」
Asuka
「No, no. Just a warning. Zero casualties, of course.」
Asuka moved her body like she would have been waving her arms, if they had been attached.
Asuka
「I had to do at least that much, or they'd try to use junk drones again, right?」
Asuka
「I can't help if it was risky. A warning needs to be all flashy, right?」
Alberta
「That is good for a threat, isn't it? It's lovely.」
Asuka
「I know, right?」
Alberta had a little bit of a wry smile, replacing the word “warning” with “threat”, but Asuka was extremely proud.
Donna
「Still, didn't you overdo it just a tad? Is that normal in the DSO?」
Donna Burroughs expressed her doubt with a serious face.

She was a former UFS soldier, and although she was not attached to the DSO, because her right Android Arm was a customized version of one of Asuka's spares, she occasionally came along to tune it up, or help Anje cook.
For some reason, due to the effects of the arm, it seemed that her sense of taste had changed, and she had both an unbelievable sweet tooth and spicy tooth.
Asuka
「That's not overdoing it at all. It's normal, normal.」
Donna
「I see. Normal, huh......?」
Asuka
「If anything, it was even restrained♪」
Masked Taimanin
「Don't lie like that.」
Peshi☆
Asuka
「Ow!」
The head of the DSO, the Masked Taimanin, had appeared without any warning whatsoever, and smacked Asuka's head with the file she was holding in her hand.
Asuka
「Hey, Madam, what're you doing?!」
Masked Taimanin
「That's my line. That last Taima Particle Cannon was going too far. Honestly. You shoot without thinking.」
Asuka
「That was to warn those guys, “This is what'll happen if you get involved with Demon World technology.”」
Asuka pouted in dissatisfaction, and Madam coldly informed her,
Masked Taimanin
「Thanks to that gratuitous little performance, your combat limbs need an overhaul.」
Asuka
「Ehhh?!! Then, I'm gonna have my normal limbs for a while?!」
Though she may have been the Steel Taimanin, that didn't mean that she had those dangerous limbs equipped with machine guns and missiles on around the clock.
In everyday life, she used Android Arms & Legs with only prosthetic functionality, and no weapons.

Of course, they were such high-spec ones that the limbs that were commercially available couldn't compare, but from Asuka's point of view, they were normal arms and legs, which didn't feel right somehow, because they
lacked things that they should have had.
Masked Taimanin
「Correct. Behave yourself with your normal limbs.」
The Masked Taimanin said, and was about to leave the lab.
Asuka
「Eh? That's it? You just came to tell me off?」
Masked Taimanin
「You want me to lecture you more? I'll keep going if you want.」
She stopped in her tracks and glared back at Asuka.
Asuka
「N-No need, no need! Goodbyyye, Madammm～～」
Masked Taimanin
「Hahhh, see you. Behave yourself now, Asuka.」
Being told to 「behave yourself」 a second time, Asuka was naturally a bit flustered, and called her boss to a halt.
Asuka
「Ah, wait, wait. It's your birthday soon, right, Madam? Is there anything you want?」
Masked Taimanin
「It'll do you no good to try and butter me up like that～」
Asuka
「Uh, no, I'm not brown-nosing, it's your present! Your birthday present!」
Masked Taimanin
「No real need. I'm not at an age you celebrate anymore, and it's not as though I've spent the whole time in this body, is it?」
The Masked Taimanin said curtly, and left the lab.
Anje
「You got told off, huh?」
Asuka
「Teensy bit. I wonder if I've fired it a bit too much lately. An overhaul, huh? I'm screwed.」
Donna
「It's the Director's birthday soon?」
Asuka
「Eh? Ah, yeah. Third of next month. She'll be...... Well, that's a secret.」
Donna
「I'm indebted to the DSO. I'd like to send her a present of some kind.」
Alberta
「I wonder if I should do so too. What sort of things does she like?」
Anje
「Tell us, Asuka.」
Asked that by the three of them, Asuka, who had known her the longest, answered,
Asuka
「She prefers simple things, nothing that grandiose. The kinda thing you can use or eat and have nothing left over afterwards.」
Asuka
「Like, last year, I got her an aromatherapy set that you use in the bath, and she was really happy.」
Asuka
「Apart from that, she likes herbal tea, so I give her quite nice ones.」
Asuka
「I guess she'd be happy with sweets too. Chocolate or something. Like, there are expensive but delicious ones that're small, but cost hundreds of yen apiece.」
Alberta
「I kind of understand. I suppose I'll get her those luxury chocolates.」
Anje
「How about some sweet bean jelly? I found a delicious restaurant the other day.」
Asuka
「That works. She likes Japanese-style sweets pretty well too, and sweet bean jelly is very Anje-ish.」
Donna
「I'll go for the herbal tea!」
Asuka
「Then that means I'll need something else. Maybe I'll go shopping during this break.」
Donna
「All the same, aromatherapy, herbal tea and sweets, huh?」
Asuka
「Mmm?」
Donna
「She's surprisingly girly.」
Asuka
「Ahaha. Yeah, that's true. Surprisingly, right?」
Asuka burst out laughing due to Donna, who said that with a serious face.
Asuka
「All right, present acquired♪」
A few days later.
Asuka had come to a particular local airport.
Since she was off-duty, not on a mission, she was clothed in her uniform.
And because the overhaul wasn't finished, her arms and legs were her everyday ones.
She had expressly come by plane to a store that was located only in the shopping area of this airport, to buy a present for the Masked Taimanin.
This was because she had remembered that Madam had previously seen it on TV or something, and taken an interest in it.
She had found a set of trendy French bath salts that were said to blossom like flowers when you put them in hot water, and was taking a break in the café space.
Asuka
「There's still some time, so I guess I'll wander around a bit.」
While looking at the clock, she was thinking about her plans after this, when
「Are you alone?」
A suit-wearing man sat down beside her and started talking to her.
Asuka
「If you're hitting on me, I'll pass.」
「That's too bad.」
He immediately stood up and left.
It wasn't unusual for her to be called out to in the streets, and she always declined, but that was surprisingly easy.
Asuka
「What a weird guy......」
Asuka was cocking her head in confusion, thinking, “It's a good thing he's not persistent, but...” when
Asuka
「What's this?」
A memory card had been left behind on the seat where the man had sat.
It couldn't be something he had forgotten.
He had only sat down for a moment. Which meant he had left it there on purpose.
But why, after going out of his way to start talking to Asuka?
Asuka
「That's blatantly suspicious.」
She picked up the memory card with her fingers.
She wanted to avoid trouble, but now that she had found it, it would feel wrong to just leave it there.
Still, today was her day off.
Asuka stood from her seat, intending to deliver it to the lost and found centre or something.
It was soon after that that things got weird.
Asuka
Strange men were following her.
They were different from the man who had hit on her earlier.
They numbered four.
They were all bald, with suits and sunglasses.
It was astoundingly suspicious.
Asuka
（Plus, those guys are......）
The movements of all four of them were too synchronized. They were as precise as machines.
Asuka
（Cyborgs, maybe? But why??）
While Asuka was wondering that, the men saw that the number of people had thinned out, and suddenly surrounded her.
Cyborg
「Woman, hand over the goods. Otherwise we'll make you suffer for it.」
Asuka
「Huh? What's this, all of a sudden?」
Cyborg
「No option. Do it!」
Asuka
「Hey?!」
This was the very definition of “no questions asked”.
Before she could tell what was what, the men launched their assault.
